tools.name: get_organisation_tenders
tools.description: List tenders an organisation published as buyer (purchase history) or won as supplier (award history).

tools.name: get_tender
tools.description: Fetch one tender by id, including its full abstract and winners.

tools.name: search_cpv_codes
tools.description: Look up Common Procurement Vocabulary codes by English keywords or browse by code prefix. Call this before search_tenders when the user describes a subject rather than giving codes.

tools.name: search_organisations
tools.description: Find buyers and suppliers by name and country. Use the returned id with get_organisation_tenders.

tools.name: search_tenders
tools.description: Search public procurement notices from TED and national portals by CPV code, buyer country, status, dates, estimated value and title. Returns a page of tenders with links to the official notices.
